notes.title: Best Walkthrough for the Enhanced Version
notes.content:
[p]Game Start:
Check the instructions on the table in the duty room. After investigating the main door, hide in the cabinet. Time and space distort... The adventure begins.[/p][p]
[/p][p]********** Battle Royale Chapter **************
Find the office key in Room 109, then return and pass by Room 106.
There is a key to the nurse's changing room on the table (useful later). Read Nurse's Diary 5 beside it. The key point is to remember that the child's birthday is on the Ghost Festival.
Return to the lobby, open the door and enter the office. Take the videotape and watch it in the lobby. Learn that the password for the rolling door is 613589.
Go to open the rolling door.
A girl in the kitchen is calling for help. Use a wrench to save her. (The wrench is randomly on the shelf in Room 106 or in the kitchen, affecting the subsequent plot.)
Use the password 613589 to open the rolling door. There is a key to Room 105 and a backpack (increases item capacity) on the table in the entertainment room.[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][p]Go to open the door of Room 105. Wait until a shadow appears. After finding that the door turns into an unbreakable wall,
An urn starts to glow. Use the ghost - expelling charm found in the cabinet in Room 105.
Leave Room 105 and receive a message from Boss Ma. Now go to the garage.
A chainsaw man appears on patrol. Avoid him and enter the staff dormitory. The chainsaw man disappears. Get the key to the master bedroom on the 2nd floor from the table.
There is a key in the hand of the boss's corpse in the garage. Exchange it with a gift box to get the key to the iron door on the 2nd floor.
Go to the 2nd floor, open the door with the two keys, enter the master bedroom, and get 4 hint papers and a yellow magnetic card.
Go to the slaughterhouse on the 1st floor and open the door. Right - click to view in the item bar and rotate the 4 hint papers. With the red frame on top, get the correct arrow directions:
Down, up, left
Up, left, down
Right, down, up
The password of the box on the chainsaw bed in the slaughterhouse is randomly 275 (connect the numbers in the order of 123435 to form a number)
or 8345 (left - right mirror image). Get the key to the freezer.[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][p]Enter the freezer. Press Q to move the carton away and get a screwdriver and wire cutters.
After getting trapped, move the wooden box away and find a ventilation duct. Use the screwdriver to open the ventilation duct and enter the conference room.
A female ghost chases after you when you come out. She will leave in about 1 minute. Then get the key to the entertainment room and the key to the monitoring room.[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][p]Open the back door of the entertainment room. First, go to the slaughterhouse and use the wire cutters to save the female streamer Xiaoying.
Then go to the monitoring room in the dormitory. Switch the camera to know that the password of the password door of Freezer 2 is 535403721.
Enter Freezer 2 through the slaughterhouse. (When chased by the chainsaw man, walk along the wall to the shortest - route cabinet to hide.) The chainsaw man will disappear.
Return to the freezer and get the key to the main door. (A curse is received here and will be lifted later.)[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][p]Open the main door of the lobby. Find that there is a wall outside. Take the key in front of Xiaoliu and go to the medical room at the deepest part of the dormitory.
Open the middle cabinet and find a little ghost. Choose option 3 to help the little ghost confirm his identity. (The choice here affects Jiaqi's ending.)
Return to the lobby. The outside of the main door becomes a corridor. (If you haven't got the key to the nurse's changing room in Room 106, get it now.)
Continue walking and enter the hospital. Read all the nurse's diaries. (There are triangle marks on the map. There are 2 diaries in the lobby.)
Walk to the emergency room to find the key to the doctor's office. Go to the doctor's office and get the key to the operating room inside.
Enter the operating room. Walk forward to the archives room and find a nurse's diary and a fuse.
Return to the duty room, install the fuse, and the elevator can be used. Take the elevator in the front lobby all the way to the - 18th floor.
Get the key to the dean's office, read a nurse's diary, take the elevator back, go to the dean's office and open the door. Find a note from the dean.
At this time, you have collected all the nurse's diaries. The password of the door is 9527.
Open the door and go to the mortuary. See several will - o' - the - wisps. Talk to the nurse's ghost and get a toy sheep.
(If you can't collect all the diaries, go to the delivery room and directly get the key to the mortuary and leave.)[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][p]Continue walking and leave the hospital. You're back at the apartment again.
First, go to the medical room, give the toy sheep to the little ghost, get the little ghost's golden body, and take him to the hospital in Huangquan Town to find the nurse.
Now go to the 2nd floor and talk to your sister. Check the lid beside the VIP - VIP area, separate the viper, and get the key to the utility room.
The rich second - generation Hao Ge is calling for help there. Get a hose in the bathroom, go downstairs to the kitchen, and pick up the fire extinguisher.
Go to the utility room to put out the fire, open the door and save the rich second - generation. (Whether to save the rich second - generation affects friendship and the ending.)
There is another key to the 2nd floor on the bed in the utility room. Go to the 2nd floor, open the door and walk to the end to get the key to Li Qi's house in Huangquan Town.
There is a hammer in the utility room next to it (affecting Siqing's life and death).
Come back and enter the painter's room. After investigation, hide in the cabinet. After Jiaqi leaves, return to the VIP area.[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][p]Pass by the VIP area and hear the sound of the faucet. Sister Siqing is trapped in the bathtub.
Investigate the faucet and choose option 3. Use the hose (there is a hose in the bathroom of the adjacent VIP - VIP area).
Then use the hammer to save Siqing. She will go to Room 204 to change clothes.
Have a conversation in Room 204. Siqing asks me to go to the lobby and take a look.
Meet sister Siyu in the lobby. There is a ghost - blocking wall at the main door. Rooster blood is needed.
Return to Room 204. Find that Room 204 has become Room 205.
There is a hint on the ground that there is a secret room in the 1st - floor conference room.[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][p]Enter the secret room of the conference room and find Xiaoliu's ID card and the key to his safe in Huangquan Town.
Also, get a rooster.
Siyu is being chased. Let her hide beside the corpse (hiding in the cabinet will lead to death). I go to lure away the chainsaw man.
(Run along the wall and quickly hide in the cabinet outside Room 108.)
Come back and let Siyu out. First, go to the kitchen, kill the rooster, and get rooster blood. A large number of corpses of the same chicken are found behind the newly opened door.
Return to the main door of the lobby and use the rooster blood to leave the apartment.
The Battle Royale chapter is over.[/p][p]
[/p][p]*************** Causality Chapter ***************
I meet a female ghost (Xiaoqian) in the pavilion in the middle of the bamboo - forest lake. Continue walking and follow the old lady to Huang's Cemetery. (Don't hide in the coffin.)
She wants to find someone to play poker with. Go to the mass grave and get a Golden Light Talisman.
In the house, the female streamer tempts me. Return to the place pointed by the female ghost outside and use the Golden Light Talisman.
Break the illusion, get 2 urns of wandering ghosts, and take them back to give to the old lady. Need to avoid being chased for 2 minutes.[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][p]Give the urns to the old lady and get an exorcism bell.
First, go to the exit square, find 5 earthen deities wearing hats, and press E to destroy the eye of the ghost - blocking formation.
Then use the exorcism bell to dispel the large - scale ghost - blocking wall and continue to move forward to reach the Lotus Park.[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][p]Get the key to the garden management office in the house directly in front of the gate or on the left. Also, get a purple umbrella (give the umbrella to Siyu later).
Get the key to the library, continue to move forward, get a jade comb in the library by the lake, and return to give it to Xiaoqian.
Talk to her for a long time. When there are 2 passers - by trying to commit suicide, choose to save them and stop them from dying.
Here, Xiaoqian's soul will scatter, leaving behind a water - spirit bead.[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][p]Get the water - spirit bead. Read the magic book and know that 2 materials can be combined to make black dog blood.
(The two materials are directly in the magic book.) (Combine and then use a bomb) Blow up the roadblock and enter the temple.
Put the money for buying life into the merit box to lift the curse and avoid being hanged in the hanging forest.
Find Videotape 2, pause the playback, and know that the solution to the Eight Trigrams is to rotate the inner, middle, and outer parts 4, 1, and 6 circles respectively.
The rotation method can be seen from the videotape screenshot. When solving the Eight - Trigrams formation, retain Xiaoqian's soul.
It can be regarded as saving Xiaoqian temporarily. Through conversation, take Xiaoqian to explore her home.
Continue to move forward.[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][p]See that my sister is being sent to Liang's Ancient Mansion in a bridal sedan chair. I follow her. The bridegroom Liang Xiaoshan asks me to help find the missing Zhu Xiaoying.
A note says that I'm participating in a live - broadcast to change fate and need to find 5 spirit beads. A note in the adjacent house says that the wood - spirit bead is buried in the leper village.
Go to Xiaoqian's house to trigger a new plot. There is a hidden compartment in the big pillar in front of the bed in the adjacent house. Get Xiaoqian's marriage certificate and hair.
Xiaoqian's house will ask you to go to the Guanyin Temple.
Return to the Lotus Park and see Siyu crying on the ground.
Give the purple umbrella to Siyu and take her to the garden management office. There are two conversation events there.[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][p]Go to the leper village alone. Meet Jiaqi and a girl named Anxin with fester skin there. Go to the 1st floor of the 3 - story building and get 2 drug combinations. Inject the girl with them. Jiaqi will give me the key to the village head's house. Find drugs and a shovel in the village head's house. A note hints that the wood - spirit bead is under the big withered tree at the end of the village. At this time, go back to find the girl. Never dig the wood - spirit bead in advance or leave the village. (This will make Jiaqi have a bad impression of me and continue to chase me. If you haven't got the shovel from the village head's house, go to the 2nd floor of the car - repair shop in Huangquan Town to get another shovel and then come back to dig the wood - spirit bead.) Return to the ward. Anxin is dead. Go to the big withered tree to bury Anxin and get the wood - spirit bead by the way. Anxin is Jiaqi's previous life, so she will have a much better impression of you and stop chasing you. She will leave drugs for you at the later save point.[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][p]Go to Huangquan Town. It's relatively simple here. Basically, search in the order of 123456789 on the map.
Get Videotape 3 in the arcade. First, go to Li Qi's house and get the key to the hospital gate.[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][p]Continue walking. Use the videotape in the alley video store and know that there is a hidden safe in the large wardrobe of Liu Huangshu's house on the 2nd floor of Rookie Alley.
The key picked up beside Liu Huangshu's corpse is for opening it.
Walk forward, open the hospital gate, give the little ghost's golden body to the nurse, and the nurse will give me a skin - peeling consent form.
This consent form affects Jiaqi's ending.
The little ghost gives me a dungeon key and also draws a picture of a imprisoned girl??
There is also Doctor Huang Lu's diary and the key to Doctor's house at No. 3, Daben Alley rental house.
There is a mechanism outside the hospital. Just make 4 green lights on. Press the unlit button again to cancel. It's very simple by the enumeration method.
Open the door and continue to move forward.[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][p]At Red Romance, see a note about Doctor Huang Lu treating Anxin. The back door of the kitchen of the Eight Immortals Restaurant opens and can lead to the coffin - shop save point.
Go to the 2nd floor of Rookie Alley, Liu Huangshu's house. Use Liu Huangshu's safe key on the big cabinet.
The password is in the book beside it. Use a pencil to blacken it and see that the password is 687 from top to bottom (the pencil is in the drawer).
Rotate 324 circles from the inside out to get the key to Liu's Casino in Nima Alley.
Go to the casino and open the door. Get the key to Boss Ma's house on the 8th floor of the inner block.
Read a note and learn that Liu Huangshu's grandfather had a tradition of raising little ghosts.
You can go to the inner block through the house at No. 2, Jianshe Road opposite Red Romance.
The key breaks into 2 halves. Need to combine them into one.
Go out and see Jiaqi coaxing the old man to poison the rich second - generation.
Go to the key - making stall at the end of Jianshe Road to make a new key (location 13 on the map).
Come back and see the rich second - generation and the old man discussing how to peek at the girl taking a bath, and then drink tea at the Eight Immortals Restaurant.
Investigate the teacup and tell the rich second - generation that there is poison in the tea. Otherwise, he will die here. (This is very important for affecting Xiaoqian's final ending!!)[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][p]Use the new key to open the house opposite Red Romance and enter the inner block.
See that the female streamer is already a bit abnormal.
See Jiaqi at the entrance of the food - stall. Give the skin - peeling consent form to Jiaqi. (The condition for Jiaqi's good ending is achieved.)
There is a Golden Light Talisman on the wall of the dining table in Ma Xiaoling's house.
There is a key to the safe in the master bedroom on the 2nd floor of the apartment in the room.
Go out and use the Golden Light Talisman on the female streamer's live - broadcast equipment. Go up to the 8th floor from the vegetable market and enter Boss Ma's house.
Read a note and learn that the female corpse is taken from Zhu Jiaming's house at No. 5, Wangba Alley. The key is hidden under the flower pot at the door.
You can get the gold - spirit bead here.
After coming out of Boss Ma's house, encounter a plot where the old man is surrounded by several ghosts. Whether to save him mainly affects Xiaoying's ending.
Choose carefully whether to save the bad old man (leave a suspense). You can get the earth - spirit bead where the old man dies. Different plots are available.[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][p]Move the flower pot away and enter Zhu Jiaming's house.
The password - lock hint is that the direction pointed by the arrow is the electronic number without lines. The answer is 5023. Get the key to Iraqi Women's Clothing.[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][p]Pass by Yilake Women's Clothing Store and go to Ma's Villa. Take Zhu Xiaoying away.
After coming out of the women's clothing store, a new Guanyin Temple scene is added. It's not far from Ma's Villa. Trigger the plot of "marrying" Xiaoqian.
This is actually the second perfect ending. After triggering, then go to Ma's Villa.[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][p]Carry Zhu Xiaoying on your back and send her back to Liang's Ancient Mansion. Get the fire - spirit bead.
My sister is also free. First, take her to the red - petal tree opposite the garden gate. There is a favor - gaining event of my sister watching fireflies.
Then take her to meet her sister away from the management office. (The good - ending condition for the two sisters is achieved.) Currently, there are 5 spirit beads.
If either of the two sisters dies, the good ending for both sisters will be gone.[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][p]Return to the apartment. Use the safe key to unlock the door on the 2nd floor. The password corresponds to the colors of the 3 throwing knives in the painting in front.
Take the magnetic card and enter the basement under the stairs. First, save the game and turn on the power.
The female ghost in the basement can be killed instantly now. Avoid her.
(If Jiaqi's favorability is full, when you walk in front of the underground office, she will help you kill the female ghost.)[/p][p][/p][p]Randomly obtain the key to the power distribution room either in the office or the operating room. Open the door and enter, then use the cell key to open the iron gate.
Release the soul of the female streamer. (If you saved the old man before, Xiaoying won't be here.)
It is recommended to run back to the corridor on the 1st floor and save the game here, which is convenient for you to view different plot developments.
Continue walking, use the five spirit beads. After a period of reminiscence, investigate the top, photos, door and TV several times.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Finally, both the red and blue buttons at the clearance area can be pressed now. Depending on the plot progression, Xiaoqian has three endings.
Game cleared!!!!!! Note that you need to choose to save Hao Ge twice before. Otherwise, only the bad ending for Xiaoqian will be available.
Including the four girls, there are a total of seven endings.[/p]

notes.title: Medium-sized update, mainly performance optimization, retranslation.
notes.content:
Medium-sized update, mainly performance optimization, retranslation,


1The actual measurement of performance optimization shows a significant increase in frame rate and improved smoothness.
2Most of the lines have been retranslated, hoping that foreigners can understand.
3Fixed 2 places with missing subtitles and voices.
 


Routine reminder:
The enhanced version does not support the saves of the old version.
(Those before December 24, 2024 are the old versions)
Old players, please uninstall the old version, browse the local files,
Open the BlurredWeirdNight_Data\data\SavedGame folder,
Delete the save files, and reinstall the enhanced version!!!
A few people have problems where the saves cannot be loaded. Usually, it is caused by not deleting the old saves.
Please select "Browse Local Files" in STEAM
Open the BlurredWeirdNight_Data\data\SavedGame folder,
Move all the saves to another folder for backup
Only keep the save with the last number
For example, if the last save is Save68.sav, rename it to Save0.sav
(.sav is the suffix. Some systems do not display it. Just change it to Save0)
Re-enter the game and it can be read successfully.

notes.title: Blurred Weird Night Enhanced Edition is online!
notes.content:
[b] Blurred Weird Night Enhanced Edition is online![/b]
[b]Warning!!![/b]
The enhanced edition does not support the saves of the old version.
It is recommended to uninstall the old version, browse the local files, 
delete the save files,
and then reinstall the enhanced edition!!!


Major update contents
1 Engine version upgrade, enhanced graphics quality
2 Added main storyline, added 2 new endings
3 Added a large number of high-energy, a large number of new side quests in the mid and late stages
4 Remade some characters, better animations, more natural expressions
5 Added a large number of sexy new costumes, all for free
6 Added 2 new scenes, deleted Old Wang's Manor, optimized running maps
7 A large number of sexy enemies in the zombie mode
8 Map improvement, fixed the deformation of corpses in the zombie mode, pause will not continue to play the language,
Various other optimizations, translation adjustments, etc.....



BUG Solution:
A few people have problems where the saves cannot be retrieved. 
Please select Browse Local Files on STEAM
Open the BlurredWeirdNight_Data\data\SavedGame folder,
Move all the saves to another folder for backup
Only keep the save with the last number
For example, if the last save is Save68.sav, rename it to Save0.sav
(.sav is the suffix. Some systems do not display it. Just change it to Save0)
Re-enter the game and you can read it successfully.

notes.title: redoing most of the translations.
notes.content: This update mainly involves redoing most of the translations. Due to the lack of funds to hire professional translators, Chinese IPs are unable to use Chapter AI and can only rely on manual and machine translation. Many Chinese specific words are difficult to explain, and the translation is not good. Please forgive me

notes.title: Updated patch on November 29th
notes.content:
Updated patch on November 29th
I spent a few days collecting bug feedback, creating patches, and then conducted a simple test for two days
We are now releasing updated patches with significant changes, and there may be differences in some item events during load SAVE
Update instructions:
Fixed the collected bugs (most of the bugs reported by the group have been resolved. If there are any omissions, please contact me)
Improved the lag in some areas on the second floor
Enhanced support for controllers and handheld computers, including the ability to switch languages and set up screens. Pressing R2 can rotate the password box to solve puzzles, etc
Reduced memory consumption
Added supplies to the apartment and reduced the difficulty of the later boss,
Added automatic running (no need to press SHIFT)
Revised some clothing patterns and lowered the volume of the music
Simplify some processes,
After obtaining the Water Spirit Pearl, you can directly obtain two materials next to the magic book without having to search for them again
The two combination props in the leprosy village are all located in the first floor warehouse on the third floor
Blocked the useless road across from the scene of the underworld wedding,
4. Some easily overlooked keys are placed in more prominent positions with arrows added
Solving some difficult problems
1. Automatically exit the game, with one out of approximately 50 people flashing,
Find local files in BlurredWeirdNight.exe. 
Right-select Properties / compatibility and set it to run as an administrator.

Solving some strange problems
A automatically exits the game, and one out of approximately 50 people crashes,
Please try the following methods
1. Search for the local file in BlurredWeirdNightexe, right-click on Properties, select Compatibility, and set it to run as an administrator
2 Open C: \ Windows \ System32 and find CMD Right click on "Run as administrator" in EXE.
Enter "sfc/scan now" at the command prompt and press enter.
The system file checking tool will automatically scan and repair damaged or missing files in the system.
3. Uninstall the game and reinstall it

B. Misorganized or no display of archives
Find local files in BlurredWeirdNight.exe. 
Right-select Properties / compatibility and set it to run as an administrator.
Please calibrate the computer time to standard time, BlurredWeirdNight_ Delete the file for Data \ data \ SavedGame and keep the archive you want. Change the name to save0 (save should be less than 800k)

notes.title: Simple Introduction and Explanation
notes.content:
Simple introduction and explanation (I don't know foreign languages, I hope you can understand)
Please provide a simple guide first. I need time to create upgrade patches, please wait for the next update
The community estimates that most people cannot open it, so it is posted on the announcement
1. Regarding the automatic shutdown of the game at the highest picture quality,
Open C:  Windows  System32 and find CMD Right click on 'Run as administrator' in EXE.
Enter "sfc/scannow" at the command prompt and press the Enter key.
The system file inspection tool will automatically scan and repair damaged or missing files in the system.
After scanning, the game returns to normal. If the problem cannot be resolved, there is a possibility of a problem with the STEAM interface
My assumption is that it is easy to pass the level and difficult to have a good ending, so the conditions for a good ending are relatively hidden
The next update will provide more prompts for items
Game Start
Found the office key at 108, and the door of 106 was opened,
There is a key to the nurse's changing room on the table, which will be useful in the future. The nurse's diary 5 next to it must be read, and the key is to remember that the child's birthday is Ghost Day
The wrench is randomly placed on the shelf of 106 or the kitchen, and there is a prompt for the shutter password in 109 on the video tape,
>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>
Go to the door of the hall and enter the office. There is a video tape on the table. Watch it in the hall and get the password 613589
A girl is trapped in the kitchen, use a wrench to save her
Go back to 107 and use the password to open the scroll gate,
There are 105 keys and expansion backpacks on the entertainment room table
>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>
Go to 105 and open the door. The item exorcism talisman found in the 105 cabinet has closed
After discovering that the door had turned into a wall, a dark shadow appeared,
A urn lit up and used the exorcism talisman found in the 105 cabinet. The door opened,
Received a message from Mr. Ma outside the restaurant, heading to the garage. There is a dangerous guy with an electric saw,
Hiding behind the car, he can't see you, or intentionally stepping on the glass to guide him to a certain place,
Entering the employee dormitory, the chainsaw man left
Speak to your sister and obtain the master's room key from the table
Place a gift box next to the body in the garage and switch to the second floor key
Go to the second floor, Jiaqi joined the team, opened the door with 2 keys and entered the master's room, obtaining 4 reminder cards and a yellow magnetic card
>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>
Go to the slaughterhouse area next to the toilet on the first floor and open the door. Rotate the four cards with red frames on them to get the password
Xiao Chen committed suicide on the way, and the female anchor was locked in the slaughterhouse with a password lock next to her
Randomly connect the password 275 (in the order of 123435) or 8345 (left and right mirror images) to obtain the freezer key
>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>
Enter the freezer and press Q to remove the cardboard box, obtain a screwdriver and thread cutting pliers
Remove the wooden box and discover the ventilation opening. Use a screwdriver to open the ventilation opening and enter the conference room,
There's a female ghost named Bai Lian chasing me out, hiding for about a minute before she leaves. You can get the entertainment room keys and surveillance room keys here
>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>
Open the back door of the entertainment room and first rescue the female anchor,
Go to the surveillance room in the dormitory again, switch the camera and know that the password for the door of freezer 2 is 535403721,
The agent is dead inside, the door key is shining brightly
>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>
Entering freezer 2 through slaughterhouse
Chased by the chainsaw man, he wants to take the shortest route to hide from the cabinet by leaning against the wall

Released tomorrow, here to answer some of the players' concerns. 

Tip: please unplug the handle or Bluetooth transmitter to play the game. 
This is the reason why some people say they can't act.


1 how long is the game? 
How difficult is it? 
A: story mode is about 7 hours, zombie mode is about 3 hours, (4 weapons, 10 BOSS). 
The difficulty is not high. 
2 Game configuration requirements? 
A: it is recommended that the graphics card is above 1060 and consume more CPU. 
Please download DEMO to try to run smoothly. 
What is the price of the game? 
A: the final price is $9.99, with the first week discount minus 10%. 

4 how long has the game been developed? 
A: there has been a plan for a long time, starting in 2016, and the first edition in 2018 is the type of detectives to find out the real killer. 
Because it is too difficult and feels unpopular to redo it, the 21-year AI dubbing version is not satisfactory. 
Remake the plot part and dubbing up to now. 
5. Do you keep the trial version? 
A: keep it. You may have another update in the future. The preliminary content is the same as the official version. 
But only play the game for 40 minutes. 
6 whether the handle is supported. 
Answer, some handles are supported, but some features or options are limited. 
Problems such as incorrect button prompts. 
I don't have enough time to test, which may be improved gradually in the future. 
7 Why is the delay so long? 
A: 
There are two main reasons: 1 I also have certain requirements for the game, which can not be released if I can't meet the basic requirements. 
2 the game was originally planned to be divided into two parts. 
I finished the complete contents of the two parts at once.

notes.title: blurred weird night will be officially released a November 17th!
notes.content:
blurred weird night will be officially released at 3 pm on November 17th!(Beijing time)

First of all, I'm sorry to have kept you waiting for a long time.
After a simple test by the internal testers, there should be no major bugs, so it is scheduled to be officially released at 3 pm on November 17th.
There are still many shortcomings, but one person's ability is limited.  We will slowly optimize and improve in the future.
Please add this game to your wishlist.  Keep an eye on this game.

A brief explanation of why the delay:
1. The developer works hard to maintain the game development,
2. The game time is several times that of similar games,
I originally planned to make the first generation, the first half of the story.  Later, I will make the second generation, the second half of the story.
But if we lose money, we won't have a chance to produce the second generation.
Therefore, the second half of the plot can be completed in one go, with the plot mode taking up to 6 hours to complete.
Zombie mode lasts for 3-4 hours, and the boss has been replaced with a more Chinese style boss.

3  I'm not satisfied with some of the original content, so I've completely rebuilt it and added some new content.
Perhaps the finished product still cannot satisfy everyone, but it is definitely much better than the discarded part.
